open_points.subject: context
open_points.text: Substitution: a request is reached only through its session, and a session's pending request is whichever was made last; a new request with the same text replaces the pending one like any other and nothing distinguishes the two.
open_points.question: Does the written-once instant at which an AccessRequest was made participate in this value model's identity, so two requests with identical text made at different instants are distinct values, or is that instant excluded from identity despite being a fact the value carries?
options: The text and made instant together identify the value; identical text submitted later creates a distinct replacement value.
Only the text determines value identity; the made instant is metadata excluded from identity.
The session slot determines identity, making AccessRequest an entity-like mutable slot rather than a value.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the complete fact set, including the made instant, as the value; a later identical request is a distinct value that replaces the earlier one.

witness.initial: A registered agent session has a pending AccessRequest with text "Access Project A" made at instant T1.
events: The agent through Kernel submits the same text again at instant T2, and the request replaces the pending request as R0-47 and R0-99 allow.
outcomes: The replacement is a distinct AccessRequest value because its made instant is T2 rather than T1.
Nothing distinguishes the replacement from the earlier AccessRequest because their text and containing session are the same.
witness.observer: The State 6 implementer defining the model's equality and persistence, and any owner-facing read that carries the made instant.
